Method of Attack: Abuse of wsreset.exe utility to delete arbitrary files by creating folder junctions (symlinks) that redirect cache deletion to privileged directories, enabling deletion of protected files without detection.
Bypassing antivirus software by deleting antivirus configuration and signature files using wsreset.exe with auto-elevated privileges.
Privilege escalation via auto-elevated execution of wsreset.exe to delete files in privileged locations.
Attack Vector: Creation of folder junctions (symbolic links) redirecting INetCookies folder to target privileged directories.
Execution of wsreset.exe which runs with elevated privileges to delete files in linked directories.
